newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica and Argentaria to be privatised in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica and Argentaria to be privatised in 1997.

text.p: Spain will sell all its shares in Telefonica and Argentaria in 1997, a government spokesman said on Monday.
An industry ministry spokesman confirmed the government plans to sell its 21.1 percent stake in Telefonica by the beginning of 1997.
The government owns 25 percent of Argentaria. The spokesman also confirmed the privatisation of 10 percent of Repsol in the spring of 1997.
By the end of 1997, a partial privatization of the electricity firm Endesa is also expected, the spokesman said. The government has a 66.6 percent stake in the company.
But before the privatisation, a new regulatory framework has to be established, the spokesman added.
Immediately following the announcement, Telefonica shares were up five pesetas to 2,440, while Repsol fell five to 4,415. Argentaria was down 40 to 5,310 and Endesa up 90 to 7,600.
